title: Keep per-type criteria validation in sync between serializer and contract
answers: Where are question criteria rules validated?
What must change when adding a question type or limit in ml_inference?
body: Per-type criteria rules exist twice: DecisionQuestion.__post_init__ (facade/contracts.py) and DecisionQuestionSerializer.validate (presentation/serializers.py). SCORE needs list of ≥2 labels; CHOICE needs non-empty dict; NOUL rejects list. Limits MAX_QUESTIONS_PER_REQUEST is enforced in both DecisionRequest and DecideRequestSerializer.validate_questions. After changing serializers, regenerate frontend/generated/{api.ts,api.schemas.ts,api.zod.ts} via `hogli build:openapi` (don't hand-edit); the frontend logic imports DecideRequestApi/DecideResponseApi from there.
applies: When changing question types, criteria rules, or request limits in ml_inference.
says: Question type validation rules: where are they enforced?
Score questions must have at least two labels available.
Maximum number of questions allowed in a single decision request.
Adding a new question type means updating validation in two places.
What criteria are required for each decision question type?
